text:
Sam (partnerships): heads-up: EdgeScale reports some of their hourly batch uploads landed with a +1h offset and a few duplicate lines. can we agree on how we want S3 batch deliveries to be treated vs direct webhook events?

Jordan [EdgeScale]: sorry about the noise. we pushed gzipped NDJSON files to the S3 ingest bucket; our writer retried on 5xx and produced new files with the same data but different filenames. we assumed your dedupe would handle content-level duplicates.

Priya (billing): for billing we dedupe by (partner_event_id OR partner_sequence_id) + entitlement_id + window_start. file-level duplicates with different event ids will be processed separately and could create charges.

Luca (eng-platform): technical note: S3-based ingestion treats each object as a batch; we currently generate an ingest_id per object. we don't inspect individual partner_event_ids during initial accept step, so duplicates can slip through if partner changes ids on retry.

Jordan [EdgeScale]: hmm, our batch writer creates a sequence_id per upload (seq-<timestamp>-<n>). but each usage line inside had a local uuid that changed when the uploader retried. migrating to stable line ids is non-trivial for their older edge devices.

Sam (partnerships): constraints: EdgeScale can't change device agents quickly; we should offer a low-friction server-side mitigation + a clear partner contract for backfills.

Luca (eng-platform): proposal: (1) support X-Partner-Sequence header for S3-object notifications (we already receive SNS events with object key) and use that sequence as a de-dupe hint; (2) run an async de-dup scan that compares content hashes for objects with same sequence_id within 24h and mark duplicates provisional before final billing; (3) provide a backfill endpoint for objects with original object_key and original_timestamp.

Priya (billing): if you mark provisional we need a reconciliation window. we can keep provisional credits/charges for up to 14 days and then finalize. backfill endpoint must include original timestamps and an explicit "backfill_flag": true field so our billing pipeline treats it as late-arriving data.

Jordan [EdgeScale]: sequence header is easy. content-hash compare sounds fine, though it may add CPU for you. backfill endpoint ok; do you need signed assertions that the backfill came from our CI/CD or device fleet?

Luca (eng-platform): add X-Partner-Signature and we will verify against the partner's public key. for S3 flow: when SNS->ingest receives object, we'll check X-Partner-Sequence (from object tagging or metadata) and compute object_sha256. if sequence matches recent object and sha256 matches, we will respond to SNS with status duplicate and emit a no-bill tag. otherwise accept and emit 202.

Priya (billing): exact responses: 202 -> {"status":"accepted","ingest_id":"ing-<id>"}; 200 -> {"status":"duplicate","reason":"sequence+hash"}; 409 -> {"status":"provisional","note":"pending_recon"} for provisional batches that require manual review.

Sam (partnerships): Jordan, can you add sequence tagging to your S3 uploads (object metadata: x-partner-sequence) and include line-level partner_event_id where possible? we understand device constraints so sequence will be primary for now.

Jordan [EdgeScale]: will add x-partner-sequence and x-partner-signature headers to object metadata. line-level ids we'll be rolling out to modern devices only; older devices will keep generating ephemeral ids.

s3-bot: lifecycle: new object detected edgescale/batches/2026-04-02/seq-20260402-0003.ndjson.gz, notification_id=nfn-334455

Luca (eng-platform): sample object metadata we'll look for:
```
x-partner-sequence: seq-20260402-0003
x-partner-signature: sha256=deadbeef...
x-partner-origin-ts: 2026-04-02T03:15:00Z
```
Luca (eng-platform): sample line format we prefer (NDJSON):
```
{"partner_event_id":"edgescale-dev-0001","entitlement_id":"ent-E45","units":50,"timestamp":"2026-04-02T03:00:00Z"}
{"partner_event_id":"edgescale-dev-0002","entitlement_id":"ent-E46","units":30,"timestamp":"2026-04-02T03:05:00Z"}
```
Priya (billing): for reconciliation please also include customer_account_id if available. if missing we'll attempt map via entitlement_id but that can slow recon.

Jordan [EdgeScale]: ack. rough rollout plan: sequence & signature metadata next 48h, then line-level partner_event_id staged to 25% of devices over 2 weeks.

Sam (partnerships): next steps: Luca to add sequence/hash dedupe + provisional tag and backfill endpoint; Priya to add provisional billing flow and 14-day window; Jordan to update S3 uploader metadata. i'll create the partner checklist and shared doc with integration steps + example payloads.

Luca (eng-platform): I'll post the ingest API contract and SNS handling doc to the partnerships drive by EOD. will include sample responses and the provisional workflow.

Priya (billing): add a note: partners must include original timestamps for late arrivals or we will assign ingest receive time as fallback (which impacts windowing).

Jordan [EdgeScale]: thanks everyone. we'll monitor and revert if we see a spike. will ping when metadata change is live. :rocket:
